text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outperforming with a 1.6% jump, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite overall cautious sentiment. The Fear & Greed index at 26 reflects genuine market anxiety, though a recent +4 point uptick hints at stabilization rather than deepening panic. Bitcoin dominance sitting at 56.2% and relatively thin $44B daily volume indicate participants are risk-averse and waiting for clearer directional signals rather than capitulating or breaking out.
